title: It's the most beautiful place I've ever been
content: This community is so fascinating and fun for me. I've always been a vivid dreamer, but I'd say that within the last two or three years was when I began to notice that I was revisiting the same place over and over. I have a lot of the same locations many of you have discussed, such as the airport with the escalators everywhere, as well as the amusement park (does anyone else have to access the water park from a really sketchy, huge slide?). In my dream-self's minds eye, it feels like everything (the airport, the amusement park, etc.) are on a huge island (kind of like in the Fortnite). Sometimes, I'll try to revisit certain places that I really loved, but for what ever reason I can't. My absolute favorite spot in my 'mall world' is way up in the mountains. I've only been there once, but it was incredible. Beautiful, old growth pine forests with sparkling, crystal-clear streams and trails that dart off in every direction. There's a huge waterfall at what feels like the "edge" of my mall world, and standing beside it, I could look out and see everything spread below. It was incredible. The feeling that I had while I was there was indescribable - just pure joy and love but ramped up to 2,000xs. I want to go back so badly, but it's like I'm blocked off from it now. It's like I wasn't supposed to be there the one time I went, and now, the powers that be won't let me. Has anyone else had a similar experience? I'm so curious to know if this was a unique experience or not. Thanks for reading!
